title: N7未充足候補4件の是正 受入確認の実測

entries.label: 再生成4件のv3検証器 単独合格
argv:
from pathlib import Path
from tools.development import issue_resolution_pilot as pilot
targets = [".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-contract-014-canonical-sequence-gaps-001--v1.json", ".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-launch-metrics-acceptance-title-001--v1.json", ".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-session-log-exit-code-doc-drift-001--v1.json", ".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-session-log-exit-code-vocabulary-001--v1.json"]
config = pilot.load_config(Path('config/development-issue-resolution-pilot-v3.json'))
for target in targets:
    pilot.validate_record_file(target, project_root=Path.cwd(), config=config)
    print(Path(target).name, 'v3検証器合格')

entries.label: N7の是正後状態（GREEN・exit 0が合格）
argv:
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['.venv/bin/python3', '-m', 'pytest', '-q',
     'tests/test_issue_intake_v4_single_candidate.py::test_n7_all_candidate_records_validate_or_are_allowlisted'],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)
print('exit', result.returncode)
print(result.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1].rsplit(' in ', 1)[0])
